scientific_integrity: Analytical geometric proof with independent numerical edge-count checks; authorship, precedence and independent mathematical validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact expectation applies to all origin-containing convex polygonal bases, while the height-optimum classification requires a centered cyclic polygon. Haar-uniform central planes only; no claim for randomly translated planes or complete section-type distribution. Classical unindexed stereology and the inaccessible detailed angle-density paper remain bibliographic risks; finite checker results do not prove the analytic statements.
title: Perimeter-controlled height transitions for random central sections of cyclic prisms
